scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @beatforge/server" "npm run dev -w @beatforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @beatforge/shared && npm run build -w @beatforge/server && npm run build -w @beatforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @beatforge/server && npm run typecheck -w @beatforge/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @beatforge/shared && npm run test -w @beatforge/server && npm run test -w @beatforge/web
